findings.title: TLS certificate error
findings.recommendation: Renew or fix the TLS certificate.

findings.title: 6 security headers missing
findings.observation: strict-transport-security (HSTS: forces HTTPS on return visits); x-frame-options (Clickjacking protection (or CSP frame-ancestors)); x-content-type-options (Stops MIME-type sniffing (value: nosniff)); referrer-policy (Controls referrer data sent to other sites); permissions-policy (Restricts camera, microphone, geolocation and other browser features); cross-origin-opener-policy (Isolates the page from cross-origin windows)
findings.recommendation: Add them in the hosting or CDN config (low-risk values in the playbook). Hygiene and trust, not a ranking factor.
findings.what_it_means: Some standard security settings are missing from your site's responses to browsers.

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy
findings.observation: CSP: limits which scripts/resources may load
findings.recommendation: Not a copy-paste fix: start with Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only, review violations, then enforce. A strict CSP applied at once can break the site.
findings.what_it_means: The site does not send a Content-Security-Policy, a rule list for which scripts may run.

findings.title: Your website opens at more than one address
findings.observation: http://127.0.0.1/: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>; https://127.0.0.1/: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>
findings.recommendation: Choose one official address and permanently (301/308) forward every other version (http/https, www/non-www) to it.
findings.what_it_means: Your website opens at more than one address (for example with and without 'www').

findings.title: Pages without a meta description
findings.observation: 1 of 4 pages have no meta description.
findings.recommendation: Write a one-sentence summary that directly answers the page's main question.
findings.what_it_means: Some pages have no meta description (the short summary search engines may show under the title).

findings.title: Domain email settings incomplete
findings.observation: No A/AAAA record for the bare domain.
findings.recommendation: Add the missing record at your DNS provider.
findings.what_it_means: Your domain's email settings (SPF/DMARC) are incomplete.

findings.title: Very short pages
findings.observation: 4 pages have fewer than 150 words of main content (read as raw HTML; content added by JavaScript is not counted: re-crawl with --render to compare).
findings.recommendation: Expand pages that should rank or be cited, or consolidate them.
findings.what_it_means: Some pages have very little text.

findings.title: No About or Contact page linked from the crawled pages
findings.recommendation: Publish About (who you are, since when, where) and Contact (address, phone) pages; they anchor the brand entity for engines and people.
findings.what_it_means: We could not find an About or Contact page.

findings.title: llms.txt not found
findings.recommendation: Optional. llms.txt is a proposed convention; major AI engines have not confirmed using it. Low effort, low priority; never a substitute for crawlable content.
findings.what_it_means: The site has no llms.txt file, a proposed file for AI tools.
